chapter.verse: Khris Jesu' sunga om nuntakna kamciam tawh kizui-in Pasian' deihna tawh Khris Jesu' sawltak khat ahi keimah Paul in,
kong it ka ta Timothy kong hopih hi. Pa Pasian leh i Topa Khris Jesu' kiangpan hehpihna, thukhualna leh nopna lemna hong tung ta hen.
A sun a zanin ka thungetna ah kong phawk den a, ka pupite mah bangin kitheihtawmna lungsim siangthotak tawh a na ka sep Pasian' tungah ka lungdam hi.
Na khituite ka phawk a, lungdamna tawh ka kidim theih nadingin nang kong mu nuam mahmah hi.
Na pi Lois leh na nu Eunice' sunga teeng masa upna, tu-in zong nang' sungah nungta ci-a ciantak ka theih, nangma' upna diktak thu ka phawk hi.
Tua thu hangin khut kong ngakna tawh nangma' sunga hong om Pasian' hehpihna gah na tawhkuang nading kong phawksak hi.
A hang pen Pasian' hong guat kha ahihleh meidawina lam hilo-in vangliatna lam, itna lam, leh kisektawmna lam hizaw hi.
Tua ahih manin i Topa' thu teci panna ah hitaleh ama' thu hangin thongkia ahi kei' vai ah hitaleh maizum kei inla Pasian' vangliatna ahi Lungdamna Thu' adingin gimna hong thuakkhawm in.
Pasian in eite' sepna hang ahilo, khanghunte kipat ma peka Khris Jesu' sungah eite hong guat ama' ngimna leh hehpihna hangin eite hong honkhia-in siangtho sapkhiatna tawh hong samkhia hi.
Tu-in tua ngimna leh hehpihna pen eite' Honpa Khris Jesu hong kilatkikna tawh hong kilaakkhia khinta hi. Amah in sihna susia-in Lungdamna Thu tungtawnin nuntakna leh sihtheihlohna hong kilangsak hi.
Tua Lungdamna Thu' adingin kei pen thuhilh sya, sawltak, leh hilhcian sya khatin hong kiseh hi.

Tu-a ka tuahkhak gimthuakna zong tua hang mah ahi hi. Himah taleh ka up kua hiam cih ka thei a, amah in kei hong ki-ap thu tua Ni dong hong kepcing sak zo ding cih lungmuang ka hih manin ka maizum kei hi.
Kei' kiangpana na zaksa thugen kilekkimte muhtheih lim bangin Khris Jesu' sunga om upna leh itna tawh lenkip in.
Nang' tunga hong ki-ap thuhoih thu, i sunga hong teeng Kha Siangtho tungtawnin kemcing in.
Na theihsa bangin Asia gam sunga omte khempeuh in kei hong nusia uh a, tuate' lakah Phygelus leh Hermogenes zong kihel hi.
Topa in Onesiphorus-te innkuan' tungah thukhualna na guan ta hen. A hang pen amah in kei hong thapia zelzel a, khutkol kibulh ka hihna hangin amah maizum lo hi.
Rome khuapi hong tun ciangin kei hong muh mateng zon cihtakin hong zong hi.
Tua Ni ciangin Topa' kiangpan thukhualna a ngah dingin Topa in amah thupha hong piaksak ta hen. Ephesus khua-a ama' hong donnate nang'n zong a kicingin na theih ahi hi.
